dedupe_keys.name: public oncology hospital pharmacy supply data chile inventory consumption lead times and demand uncertainty studies

description: These two deposits publish the real operating data of the pharmacy of a public cancer hospital in Chile, so that others can study how hospitals keep medicines in stock when demand and deliveries are uncertain. The producer is Fernando Rojas of the Universidad de Valparaíso. The first deposit holds the raw data layers: stock parameters and item classifications, monthly consumption in 2023 and 2024, purchase lead times and arrival patterns by procurement channel, including the national public supply centre CENABAST, inventory and overstock values, prices, stockouts and losses, and purchasing costs. The second gives 48 months of demand and cost for 13 anonymised medicines, fitted demand distributions and a Monte Carlo study used to derive simple rules for choosing inventory models. Coverage is one hospital. Both deposits are available as free downloads from Zenodo with code, under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: one hospital, some file and column names are in Spanish, medicine identities are hidden in the second deposit, and there is no patient information. Simulation uses: modelling medicine stockouts when supply lead times grow in a disruption, sizing safety stocks for hospital resilience, and testing procurement policies. Related records: BloodPath (model-bloodpath) models another hospital supply chain, and the ARCOS opioid distribution data (data-arcos-opioid-distribution-paths) trace national medicine flows.
name: Public oncology hospital pharmacy supply data, Chile (inventory, consumption, lead times and demand uncertainty studies)
schema_summary: Stock parameters and ABC/XYZ classes; monthly consumption 2023 to 2024; purchase lead times and arrivals by procurement channel (including CENABAST); inventory levels and overstock values; item master with price and formulation; stockouts and losses; indirect and purchasing process costs. Second deposit: 48 months of demand and cost for 13 anonymised medicines (M01 to M13) with fitted demand distributions and Monte Carlo outputs

sources.note: Creator Rojas (Universidad de Valparaíso); CC BY 4.0; published 2026-03-03; 16 files incl. Inventario.xlsx, Parametros de stock.xlsx, Arsenal.xlsx, IC CENABAST.xlsx, cost files; raw operational data from a public oncology hospital: ABC/XYZ classes and stock parameters (s, SS, Q), monthly consumption 2023-2024, purchase lead times and arrival patterns by procurement channel, inventory and overstock, item master with price and formulation, stockouts and losses; no patient-level data; reproducible pipeline

Same creator; CC BY 4.0; published 2026-09-03; anonymised demand and cost for 13 medicines over 48 months; fits normal, gamma, negative binomial II and zero-inflated negative binomial models; one-cycle stochastic inventory cost evaluation; Monte Carlo study of model choice; two zip files
